resources.string: Every card costs more output than plain text, so replies take longer.
Some cards use the internet when they are shown: maps (OpenStreetMap, Photon), photos (Wikipedia, Openverse) and weather (Open-Meteo).
Changing this rebuilds this chat\'s cache once.
New chats start with interactive cards on. Applies to every chat you create; existing chats keep their own setting.
